questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 4: the Vice President serves six years and shall not serve more than two successive terms. Unlike the President, the Vice President is not barred from re-election.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, which body canvasses the votes for President and Vice President and proclaims the winners?
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 4: the certificates of canvass are sent to the Senate President, and Congress canvasses the votes in joint public session. The Supreme Court sitting en banc is the sole judge of election contests for these offices.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What vote does Congress need to override a presidential veto of a bill?
questions.correct: Two-thirds of all the Members of each House
wrong: A majority of all the Members of each House
Three-fourths of all the Members of each House
Two-thirds of the Members present in joint session
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 27(1): a vetoed bill becomes law if each House, voting separately, approves it again by two-thirds of all its Members.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Appropriation, revenue and tariff bills must originate exclusively in which body?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 24: these bills, along with bills increasing the public debt, bills of local application and private bills, originate exclusively in the House. The Senate may propose or concur with amendments.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, a treaty or international agreement is valid only if concurred in by what vote?
questions.correct: At least two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate
wrong: A majority of all the Members of the Senate
Two-thirds of all the Members of Congress voting jointly
A majority of all the Members of the House of Representatives
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 21: no treaty or international agreement shall be valid and effective unless concurred in by at least two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The President appoints Justices of the Supreme Court from a list of at least how many nominees prepared by the Judicial and Bar Council for every vacancy?
questions.explanation: Article VIII, Section 9: appointments are made from a list of at least three nominees prepared by the Judicial and Bar Council, and they need no confirmation by the Commission on Appointments.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The Commission on Elections is composed of a Chairman and how many Commissioners?
questions.explanation: Article IX-C, Section 1(1): the COMELEC has a Chairman and six Commissioners. The Civil Service Commission and the Commission on Audit each have a Chairman and two Commissioners.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article XI, Section 5, the Office of the Ombudsman has an overall Deputy and at least one Deputy each for which areas?
wrong: Metro Manila, the provinces and the overseas posts
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 5: the Office is composed of the Ombudsman (Tanodbayan), one overall Deputy and at least one Deputy each for Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. A separate Deputy for the military establishment may also be appointed.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Article II, Section 12 directs the State to equally protect the life of the mother and the life of the unborn from when?
wrong: From the third month of pregnancy
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 12: the State shall equally protect the life of the mother and the life of the unborn from conception.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article XIV, Section 2, the State must maintain a system of free public education at which levels?
questions.explanation: Article XIV, Section 2(2) provides free public education in the elementary and high school levels, and makes elementary education compulsory for all children of school age.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, which sector must be given the highest budgetary priority?
questions.explanation: Article XIV, Section 5(5): the State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to education.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: According to Article XV, Section 1, what does the State recognize as the foundation of the nation?
questions.explanation: Article XV, Section 1 recognizes the Filipino family as the foundation of the nation. Section 2 calls marriage an inviolable social institution and the foundation of the family.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Congress, acting as a constituent assembly, may propose amendments to the Constitution upon a vote of how many of all its Members?
questions.explanation: Article XVII, Section 1: amendments may be proposed by Congress upon a vote of three-fourths of all its Members, or by a constitutional convention. Under Section 3, Congress calls a convention by a two-thirds vote.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: If the President does not act on a bill within how many days after receiving it, the bill becomes law as if signed?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 27(1): a bill becomes law if the President does not communicate a veto to the House where it originated within thirty days after the date of receipt.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: When the President of the Philippines is on trial in an impeachment case, who presides over the Senate?
questions.correct: The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 3(6): when the President is on trial, the Chief Justice presides but does not vote. Conviction needs two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Article II, Section 16 says the State shall protect and advance the right of the people to what?
wrong: Free use of all natural resources
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 16: the State shall protect and advance the right of the people to a balanced and healthful ecology in accord with the rhythm and harmony of nature.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, Section 7(a), public officials may not have a financial or material interest in what?
questions.correct: Any transaction requiring the approval of their office
wrong: Any company listed on the stock exchange
Any property inherited from their parents
Any savings account in a private bank
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 7(a) prohibits public officials and employees from directly or indirectly having any financial or material interest in any transaction requiring the approval of their office.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, Section 7(c), what may public officials NOT do with confidential information they learned because of their office and that is not available to the public?
wrong: Keep it in the office files
Use it in their official work
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 7(c) prohibits disclosing or misusing confidential or classified information officially known to them by reason of their office, to further their private interests or give undue advantage to anyone.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, Section 3(c), which of the following is excluded from the definition of a "gift"?
questions.correct: An unsolicited gift of nominal or insignificant value not given in anticipation of a favor
wrong: A simulated sale of property at a token price
A cash gift given in exchange for a favor already done
An expensive gift solicited from a client of the office
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 3(c) defines a gift to include simulated sales and onerous dispositions, but excludes an unsolicited gift of nominal or insignificant value not given in anticipation of, or in exchange for, a favor.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, Section 8(B), public officials must disclose their relatives in government up to what degree of consanguinity or affinity?
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 8(B) requires officials to identify and disclose relatives in government within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity, including bilas, inso and balae.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Besides their own, whose assets and liabilities must a public official include in the SALN under RA 6713?
questions.correct: Their spouse and unmarried children under 18 living in their household
wrong: All relatives within the fourth civil degree
Their spouse only, if also in government
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 8(A) requires the SALN to cover the assets, liabilities and business interests of the official, the spouse, and unmarried children under eighteen years of age living in their households.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which agency has the primary responsibility for administering and enforcing RA 6713?
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 12 gives the Civil Service Commission primary responsibility for administering and enforcing the Act and for issuing its implementing rules.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which RA 6713 norm of conduct asks officials to discourage wrong perceptions of their roles as dispensers or peddlers of undue patronage?
questions.explanation: RA 6713, Section 4(b), professionalism: officials must perform their duties with excellence, intelligence and skill, and discourage wrong perceptions of their roles as dispensers or peddlers of undue patronage.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Article 1 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights states that all human beings are born free and equal in what?
questions.explanation: UDHR, Article 1: "All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights."

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law is the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons, later renamed the Magna Carta for Persons with Disability?
questions.explanation: RA 7277 (1992) is the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons; RA 9442 (2007) amended it and changed its title. RA 9994 is the Expanded Senior Citizens Act, RA 9208 the Anti-Trafficking law, and RA 8371 the IPRA.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 9994, the Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010, what discount do senior citizens get on covered goods and services such as medicines?
questions.explanation: RA 9994, Section 4 grants senior citizens (Filipinos aged 60 and above) a 20% discount and exemption from value-added tax on covered goods and services.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 9208 is known as what law?
wrong: Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995
questions.explanation: RA 9208 is the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2003, later strengthened by RA 10364, the Expanded Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2012. The Migrant Workers Act is RA 8042 and the Anti-Torture Act is RA 9745.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the Indigenous Peoples' Rights Act (RA 8371), the consensus of an indigenous community, reached through its customary practices and free of manipulation, before a project enters its ancestral domain is called what?
questions.explanation: RA 8371, Section 3(g) defines free and prior informed consent (FPIC), which must be secured from indigenous communities before activities affecting their ancestral domains. The National Commission on Indigenous Peoples oversees the process.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 12, a person under investigation for an offense has the right to what kind of counsel?
questions.correct: Competent and independent counsel, preferably of his own choice
wrong: Any counsel assigned by the investigating officer
Counsel only after charges are filed in court
Counsel only if he can pay for one
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 12(1): the person must be informed of the right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel preferably of his own choice; if he cannot afford one, counsel must be provided. These rights can be waived only in writing and in the presence of counsel.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law penalizes crimes against international humanitarian law, genocide and other crimes against humanity in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: RA 9851 (2009) is the Philippine Act on Crimes Against International Humanitarian Law, Genocide, and Other Crimes Against Humanity. RA 9745 is the Anti-Torture Act, RA 9372 the Human Security Act of 2007, and RA 11479 the Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 8550, later amended by RA 10654, is known as what law?
wrong: Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act
questions.explanation: RA 8550 is the Philippine Fisheries Code of 1998, amended by RA 10654 in 2015. The Mining Act is RA 7942, the Revised Forestry Code is PD 705, and the wildlife law is RA 9147.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law regulates toxic chemicals and hazardous and nuclear wastes in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: RA 6969 is the Toxic Substances and Hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act of 1990. RA 9003 covers solid waste, RA 8749 is the Clean Air Act, and RA 7942 is the Mining Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: In the Philippines, El Niño is usually associated with what weather condition?
questions.correct: Below-normal rainfall that can lead to drought
questions.explanation: El Niño is the unusual warming of sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific; PAGASA notes it usually brings below-normal rainfall to the Philippines. La Niña, the cooling phase, usually brings above-normal rainfall.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the greenhouse effect?
questions.correct: The trapping of heat in the atmosphere by gases such as carbon dioxide
wrong: The thinning of the ozone layer by CFCs
The rise in sea level from melting ice
The acidification of rain by sulfur dioxide
questions.explanation: Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide, methane and water vapor let sunlight in but trap outgoing heat, warming the Earth. Ozone thinning is a separate problem addressed by the Montreal Protocol.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which of the following best describes sustainable development?
questions.correct: Development that meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs
wrong: Development that maximizes economic growth regardless of environmental cost
Development that stops all use of natural resources
Development that is funded only by foreign aid
questions.explanation: This is the definition in the 1987 Brundtland Report, Our Common Future, by the World Commission on Environment and Development.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: In the solid waste management hierarchy, which option is the most preferred?
questions.correct: Preventing and reducing waste at the source
wrong: Disposing of waste in a sanitary landfill
questions.explanation: The hierarchy ranks prevention and reduction first, then reuse and recycling, then recovery, with disposal as the last resort. RA 9003 likewise stresses waste reduction at the source before recycling and disposal.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 10121, who chairs the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council?
wrong: Secretary of the Interior and Local Government
Secretary of Social Welfare and Development
questions.explanation: RA 10121, Section 5 makes the Secretary of National Defense the Chairperson. The DILG, DSWD, DOST and NEDA Secretaries are Vice Chairpersons, and the Office of Civil Defense serves as secretariat.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What does the term biodiversity refer to?
questions.correct: The variety of life, including genes, species and ecosystems
wrong: The number of people living in an area
The breakdown of waste by microorganisms
The movement of water through the environment
questions.explanation: The Convention on Biological Diversity (Article 2) defines biological diversity as the variability among living organisms, including diversity within species, between species and of ecosystems.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 7080, the Anti-Plunder Act, a public officer commits plunder by amassing ill-gotten wealth of at least what total amount?
questions.explanation: RA 7080, Section 2, as amended by RA 7659, sets the threshold at an aggregate amount or total value of at least fifty million pesos.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which issuance put Freedom of Information into effect in the Executive Branch?
questions.explanation: EO No. 2, s. 2016 operationalizes the people's constitutional right to information (Article III, Section 7) in the Executive Branch. EO 292 is the Administrative Code of 1987, EO 192 reorganized the DENR, and EO 209 is the Family Code.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which address is exactly the same as: 27-B Rizal Ave., Brgy. 4, Tacloban City 6500?
questions.explanation: Compare part by part: number, street name, street type, barangay, city and ZIP code. Only the first choice matches all of them.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many differences are there between these two addresses? "Unit 5C, 88 Kalayaan Ave., Diliman, Quezon City 1101" and "Unit 5C, 88 Kalayaan Ave., Diliman, Quezon City 1011"
questions.explanation: Everything matches except the ZIP code: 1101 in the first and 1011 in the second. That is one difference.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many differences are there between "Lot 12 Blk 3, Phase 2, Camella Homes, Bacoor, Cavite" and "Lot 12 Blk 8, Phase 2, Camella Homes, Bacoor, Cavite"?
questions.explanation: Only the block number differs: Blk 3 in the first and Blk 8 in the second.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which pair of addresses is exactly alike?
questions.correct: 1450 F. Benitez St., Malate / 1450 F. Benitez St., Malate
wrong: 1450 F. Benitez St., Malate / 1450 F. Benitez Ave., Malate
1450 F. Benitez St., Malate / 1405 F. Benitez St., Malate
1450 F. Benitez St., Malate / 1450 F. Benites St., Malate
questions.explanation: The other pairs differ in one detail: St. and Ave., 1450 and 1405, or Benitez and Benites.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which name is exactly the same as: Ma. Theresa D. Villanueva-Ocampo?
questions.explanation: The others change one detail: Teresa without the h, the middle initial B, or a missing hyphen.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many of these pairs are exactly alike? (1) Rodrigo P. Manalastas / Rodrigo P. Manalastas (2) Evangeline S. Dimaculangan / Evangeline S. Dimaculagan (3) Jose Ma. B. Lacson / Jose Ma. B. Lacson (4) Cristina T. Ylagan / Christina T. Ylagan
questions.explanation: Pairs 1 and 3 are identical. Pair 2 drops an "n" (Dimaculagan) and pair 4 adds an "h" (Christina).

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which pair of names is exactly alike?
questions.correct: Feliciano R. Macapagal Jr. / Feliciano R. Macapagal Jr.
wrong: Feliciano R. Macapagal Jr. / Feliciano R. Macapagal Sr.
Feliciano R. Macapagal Jr. / Feliciano P. Macapagal Jr.
Feliciano R. Macapagal Jr. / Feliciano R. Makapagal Jr.
questions.explanation: The other pairs differ in the suffix (Jr. and Sr.), the middle initial (R and P), or the spelling (Macapagal and Makapagal).

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Compare "Alfonso Q. Guanzon-Bautista III" with "Alfonso Q. Guanson-Bautista III". Where is the difference?
questions.correct: In the first surname: Guanzon and Guanson
questions.explanation: The middle initial Q and the suffix III match. The first surname changes "z" to "s".

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which number is exactly the same as 3048-2719-6650?
questions.explanation: Check each group of digits. The other choices swap two digits in one group.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many of these pairs are exactly alike? 58209 / 58209; 774031 / 774013; 1096.45 / 1096.45; 30-2851-77 / 30-2815-77
questions.explanation: The first and third pairs match. In the second pair 031 becomes 013, and in the fourth 2851 becomes 2815.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: In the list 4417, 4471, 4417, 4714, 4417, 4174, how many times does 4417 appear?
questions.explanation: It appears first, third and fifth. The others use the same digits in a different order.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Compare the TIN 123-456-789-000 with 123-465-789-000. Where is the difference?
questions.explanation: The first, third and last groups match. The second group swaps the 5 and the 6.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Treating prefixes as part of the surname and ignoring spaces, which name is filed first? Dela Cruz, Juan; De Guzman, Ana; Delos Santos, Carla; Del Rosario, Ben
questions.explanation: Read them as DEGUZMAN, DELACRUZ, DELOSSANTOS and DELROSARIO. "DEG" comes before "DEL", so De Guzman is first.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Filing letter by letter exactly as written, which name is filed third? McArthur, Leo; MacDonald, Rita; Macaraeg, Jun; Mabini, Tess
questions.explanation: The order is MABINI, MACARAEG, MACDONALD, MCARTHUR. "MACA" comes before "MACD", and "MAC" comes before "MCA", so MacDonald is third.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How is the name "Dr. Ana Marie Tan" indexed for filing?
questions.explanation: Index by surname first, then the given names. A title such as Dr. is placed at the end in parentheses and is not used for sorting.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How is the business name "The Manila Times" indexed for filing?
questions.explanation: The article "The" at the start of a business name is moved to the end, so the name files under M.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: In straight numeric filing, which folder comes first: 2025-0187, 2025-0078, 2024-0912, 2025-0102?
questions.explanation: Compare the first group: 2024 comes before 2025, so 2024-0912 is first regardless of the second group.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: In terminal-digit filing, which part of the record number 48-27-15 is used first to find the file?
wrong: The whole number read from left to right
questions.explanation: Terminal-digit filing reads the number from the right: the last group (15) is the primary section, then 27, then 48.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Letters are filed with the most recent in front. Which letter is second from the front? March 3, 2026; January 28, 2026; March 15, 2026; February 10, 2026
questions.explanation: Newest first: March 15, March 3, February 10, January 28. The second from the front is March 3, 2026.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Arranged from oldest to newest, which date comes third? July 9, 2025; May 30, 2025; July 1, 2025; June 14, 2025
questions.explanation: Oldest to newest: May 30, June 14, July 1, July 9. The third is July 1, 2025.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A hospital files patient records by an assigned number instead of by name, to protect privacy. Which filing system is this?
questions.explanation: Numeric filing uses numbers instead of names, which also keeps names off the folder labels.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: An office files its records under headings such as "Budget", "Personnel" and "Training". Which filing system is this?
questions.explanation: Subject filing arranges records by topic or activity rather than by name, place, number or date.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: What is a records retention schedule?
questions.correct: A list of how long each type of record must be kept before it can be disposed of
wrong: A list of employees allowed to open the files
A log of documents received each day
questions.explanation: A retention schedule sets the period each kind of record is kept, and what happens to it afterwards.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Under RA 9470, which agency must authorize the disposal of government records?
questions.explanation: The National Archives of the Philippines Act of 2007 (RA 9470) makes the National Archives responsible for approving the disposal of public records.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: An incoming letter is stamped "Received" with the date and time. What is the main purpose of this?
questions.correct: To record when the office received it, for tracking and deadlines
wrong: To show that the letter has been answered
To approve the request in the letter
To mark the letter as confidential
questions.explanation: The receiving stamp proves when the document arrived, which matters for routing, follow-up and response deadlines.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: You take a phone message for a co-worker who is out. Which set of details should you write down?
questions.correct: The caller's name and number, the message, and the date and time of the call
wrong: Only the caller's name, since your co-worker can look up the rest
Only the message, since the caller will call again anyway
The caller's name and a short note on how they sounded
questions.explanation: A complete message lets your co-worker return the call and act on it without having to guess.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which part of a business letter contains the main message?
questions.explanation: The body, between the salutation and the complimentary close, carries the message of the letter.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: In a formal business letter, which punctuation usually follows the salutation "Dear Mr. Santos"?
questions.explanation: Formal business letters use a colon after the salutation. A comma is common in personal letters.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is capitalized correctly?
questions.correct: The Civil Service Commission has its main office in Quezon City.
wrong: The civil service commission has its main office in Quezon city.
The Civil Service commission has its Main Office in Quezon City.
the Civil Service Commission has its main office in quezon City.
questions.explanation: Capitalize the first word, and every main word in the names of agencies and places: Civil Service Commission, Quezon City.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is capitalized correctly?
questions.correct: We celebrate Independence Day every June 12.
wrong: We celebrate independence day every June 12.
We celebrate Independence day every june 12.
We Celebrate Independence Day Every June 12.
questions.explanation: Holidays and months are proper nouns and are capitalized. Ordinary words in the sentence are not.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
questions.correct: On June 12, 2026, the office will be closed.
wrong: On June 12 2026 the office will be closed.
On June, 12 2026, the office will be closed.
On June 12, 2026 the office, will be closed.
questions.explanation: A comma goes between the day and the year, and another after the year when the date opens the sentence.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which phrase shows a lounge that belongs to all the employees?
questions.explanation: For a plural noun ending in s, add only an apostrophe: employees'. "Employee's" would mean one employee.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Conscientious is "con" + "science" without the final e + "tious": c-o-n-s-c-i-e-n-t-i-o-u-s.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: An office buys 12 reams of paper at ₱245 each and 5 boxes of pens at ₱180 each. What is the total cost?

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A clerk encodes 45 forms per hour. How many hours will 630 forms take?

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A citizen asks about a delayed passport application. Which agency handles this?
questions.explanation: Passports are issued by the Department of Foreign Affairs.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Rosa walks 5 km north, then 3 km east, then 5 km south. Where is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: The 5 km north and 5 km south cancel out, leaving only the 3 km east.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Ben faces north. He turns 90° to his right, then turns 180°. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: A right turn from north faces east. Turning 180° from east faces west.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: A car travels 6 km east and then 8 km north. What is the straight-line distance from its starting point?
questions.explanation: The path forms a right triangle: √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Just after sunrise, Lito stands so that his shadow falls to his right. Which direction is he facing?
questions.explanation: At sunrise the sun is in the east, so shadows point west. If west is on his right, he is facing south.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Ana's house is west of the market. The church is north of the market. In which direction is the church from Ana's house?
questions.explanation: From Ana's house, the market is to the east, and the church is north of the market, so the church is to the northeast.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which does not belong with the others? Rose, Tulip, Orchid, Mango
questions.explanation: Rose, tulip and orchid are flowers; a mango is a fruit.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which number does not belong? 9, 25, 49, 64, 81
questions.explanation: All are perfect squares, but 9, 25, 49 and 81 are squares of odd numbers (3, 5, 7, 9). 64 is the square of an even number.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which does not belong with the others? Plumber, Carpenter, Electrician, Hammer
questions.explanation: Plumber, carpenter and electrician are workers; a hammer is a tool.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which does not belong with the others? Kilometer, Meter, Liter, Centimeter
questions.explanation: Kilometer, meter and centimeter measure length; a liter measures volume.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which pair does not follow the same rule as the others? 3-9, 4-16, 5-25, 6-30
questions.explanation: In the other pairs the second number is the square of the first. 6² is 36, not 30.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Rita has more money than Sam but less than Tom. Uma has more money than Tom. Who has the least money?
questions.explanation: From most to least: Uma, Tom, Rita, Sam.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a row of 20 chairs, Mon sits in the 8th chair from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from the right = 20 − 8 + 1 = 13.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a race, P finished before Q, R finished after Q, and S finished before P. Who finished first?
questions.explanation: The order is S, P, Q, R.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five books are stacked. History is at the top and Filipino is at the bottom. Math is above Science but below English. Which book is in the middle?
questions.explanation: From the top: History, English, Math, Science, Filipino. Math is third, in the middle.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? D, H, L, P, ...
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by four: D, H, L, P, then T.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? Z, X, V, T, R, ...
questions.explanation: Each letter skips one going backward: Z, X, V, T, R, P.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? AB, DE, GH, JK, ...
questions.explanation: Each pair starts three letters after the previous pair: A, D, G, J, M. So the next pair is MN.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? B, E, H, K, N, ...
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by three: N + 3 = Q.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a code, BOOK is written CQRO: the letters move forward by 1, 2, 3 and 4. How is CAKE written in the same code?

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: If MANILA is written as ALINAM, how is CEBU written?
questions.explanation: The word is written backward. CEBU reversed is UBEC.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 and so on, what word is 8-5-12-16?

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a code, a word equals the sum of its letter positions (A = 1, B = 2, ...). SUN = 54. What does MOON equal?

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Bee is to hive as bird is to ___.
questions.explanation: The relationship is an animal and the home it builds.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pilot is to airplane as captain is to ___.
questions.explanation: The relationship is the person in command and what they command.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Hot is to cold as ancient is to ___.
questions.explanation: The words are opposites. The opposite of ancient is modern.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which statement means the same as "If a document is signed, it is valid"?
questions.correct: If a document is not valid, it is not signed
wrong: If a document is valid, it is signed
If a document is not signed, it is not valid
questions.explanation: A rule "if A, then B" is equivalent to "if not B, then not A". The other choices reverse or negate it wrongly.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which statement contradicts "All the applicants passed the exam"?
questions.correct: At least one applicant did not pass
wrong: No one outside the applicants passed
questions.explanation: To contradict "all passed", it is enough that one applicant failed. The other statements can be true at the same time.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: If "Some teachers are coaches" is true, which statement must also be true?
questions.explanation: A "some" statement can be turned around: if some teachers are coaches, those people are coaches who are teachers.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which statement means the same as "No reviewers are lazy"?
questions.correct: No lazy person is a reviewer
questions.explanation: A "no" statement works both ways: if no reviewer is lazy, then no lazy person is a reviewer.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: An office's budget is ₱600,000 for salaries, ₱150,000 for supplies, ₱90,000 for travel and ₱60,000 for utilities. About what percent goes to supplies?

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pointing to a man, Liza says, "He is the son of my mother's only brother." How is the man related to Liza?
questions.explanation: Liza's mother's brother is her uncle, and her uncle's son is her cousin.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 2 of the 1987 Constitution, who may issue a search warrant or a warrant of arrest?
questions.correct: A judge, after personally examining the complainant and witnesses under oath
wrong: The chief of police, after a sworn complaint is filed at the station
A prosecutor, after reviewing the police report and the evidence
A barangay captain, when the suspect is likely to leave the area
questions.explanation: Only a judge may issue warrants, and only on probable cause determined personally after examining the complainant and witnesses under oath.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Article III, Section 20 of the 1987 Constitution says no person shall be imprisoned for what?
questions.correct: Debt or non-payment of a poll tax
questions.explanation: Section 20 provides that no person shall be imprisoned for debt or non-payment of a poll tax.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 9, private property shall not be taken for public use without what?
questions.explanation: The government may take private property for public use (eminent domain), but it must pay just compensation.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 13, when may bail be denied before conviction?
questions.correct: When the offense is punishable by reclusion perpetua and the evidence of guilt is strong
wrong: When the accused has been charged with any crime more than once before
When the prosecutor objects and the judge agrees that the case is serious
When the writ of habeas corpus has been suspended in the whole country
questions.explanation: All persons are entitled to bail before conviction, except those charged with offenses punishable by reclusion perpetua when evidence of guilt is strong. The right to bail is not impaired even when the writ of habeas corpus is suspended.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: A law punishes an act that was legal at the time it was done. Which constitutional rule does it violate?
questions.correct: The ban on ex post facto laws
wrong: The right to a speedy trial
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 22 provides that no ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Article III, Section 7 recognizes the right of the people to what?
questions.correct: Information on matters of public concern
wrong: Free legal fees in all cases
questions.explanation: Section 7 guarantees access to official records and documents on matters of public concern, subject to limits set by law.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 18, no person shall be detained solely by reason of what?
questions.explanation: Section 18(1) provides that no person shall be detained solely by reason of political beliefs and aspirations.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 14, how is an accused person regarded until the contrary is proved?
questions.explanation: In all criminal prosecutions, the accused is presumed innocent until the contrary is proved.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 3(2), how is evidence obtained through an illegal search or a violation of the privacy of communication treated?
questions.correct: It is inadmissible for any purpose in any proceeding
wrong: It may be used if it proves guilt
It may be used only in civil cases
It is admissible once a warrant is issued later
questions.explanation: Section 3(2) makes evidence obtained in violation of Sections 2 and 3 inadmissible for any purpose in any proceeding.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article III, Section 15, the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus may be suspended only in which cases?
questions.correct: Invasion or rebellion, when public safety requires it
wrong: Any national emergency declared by Congress
questions.explanation: Section 15 allows suspension only in cases of invasion or rebellion, when public safety requires it.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 10121, what share of a local government's estimated revenue from regular sources is set aside as the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund?
questions.explanation: RA 10121 requires not less than 5% of the estimated revenue from regular sources to be set aside for the LDRRMF.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 10121, how much of the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund is allocated as a Quick Response Fund?
questions.explanation: Thirty percent of the LDRRMF is set aside as a Quick Response Fund for relief and recovery programs.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which office serves as the secretariat of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council?
questions.explanation: Under RA 10121, the Office of Civil Defense serves as the secretariat and executive arm of the NDRRMC.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which government agency monitors volcanoes and earthquakes in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), under the DOST, monitors volcanoes, earthquakes and tsunamis.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: When an earthquake strikes while you are indoors, what is the recommended action?
wrong: Use the elevator to get downstairs
questions.explanation: Drop to the ground, take cover under sturdy furniture, and hold on until the shaking stops.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which agency raises the tropical cyclone wind signals in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: PAGASA, the weather agency under the DOST, issues tropical cyclone warnings and wind signals.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which office leads the government's peace process, reconciliation and unity efforts?
questions.correct: Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity
wrong: Department of the Interior and Local Government
questions.explanation: OPAPRU, formerly the Office of the Presidential Adviser on the Peace Process (OPAPP), oversees the comprehensive peace process.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) replaced which region?
questions.correct: The Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM)
questions.explanation: The Bangsamoro Organic Law (RA 11054) abolished the ARMM and created the BARMM in its place.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 11188 gives special protection to which group?
questions.correct: Children in situations of armed conflict
questions.explanation: RA 11188 (2019) is the Special Protection of Children in Situations of Armed Conflict Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The International Day of Peace is observed every year on what date?
questions.explanation: The United Nations observes the International Day of Peace every September 21.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which United Nations Sustainable Development Goal is about peace, justice and strong institutions?
questions.explanation: SDG 16 promotes peaceful and inclusive societies, access to justice and accountable institutions.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: By what year are the 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals meant to be achieved?
questions.explanation: The Sustainable Development Goals were adopted in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 10627 of 2013 requires schools to adopt policies against what?
questions.explanation: RA 10627, the Anti-Bullying Act of 2013, requires elementary and secondary schools to adopt anti-bullying policies.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 11036 of 2018 is known as what law?
questions.explanation: RA 11036, the Mental Health Act, establishes a national mental health policy and protects the rights of service users.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 10354 of 2012 is commonly known as what?
questions.correct: Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act
questions.explanation: RA 10354 is the Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act of 2012, often called the RH Law.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 11648 of 2022 raised the age of sexual consent in the Philippines to what age?
questions.explanation: RA 11648 raised the age for determining statutory rape from 12 to 16 years old.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which United Nations treaty, adopted in 1984, specifically prohibits torture?
wrong: Convention on the Rights of the Child
questions.explanation: The Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment was adopted by the UN General Assembly in 1984.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law created the National Archives of the Philippines and governs the keeping of public records?
questions.explanation: RA 9470, the National Archives of the Philippines Act of 2007, governs the management and preservation of public records.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 11032, what is the maximum processing time for applications that need highly technical evaluation?
questions.explanation: RA 11032 sets 3 working days for simple, 7 for complex, and 20 for highly technical applications.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 11032, what is the maximum processing time for complex transactions?
questions.explanation: Complex transactions must be completed within 7 working days.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which constitutional commission examines and audits government funds and property?
questions.explanation: Article IX-D of the 1987 Constitution gives the Commission on Audit the power to examine, audit and settle government accounts.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The Sandiganbayan is a special court that mainly tries which kind of cases?
questions.correct: Graft and corruption cases involving public officials
questions.explanation: The Sandiganbayan is an anti-graft court with jurisdiction over graft and corruption cases committed by public officials.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What does the "zero-contact policy" under RA 11032 aim to prevent?
questions.correct: Unnecessary contact between applicants and processing staff that can lead to fixing or bribery
wrong: Applicants filing documents in person at the government office
Phone calls and emails between government offices and the public
Supervisors meeting with their own staff during office hours
questions.explanation: Except during preliminary assessment, processing staff should have no contact with applicants, to reduce red tape, fixing and bribery.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A cyclist rides 18 km in 1 hour 12 minutes. What is the average speed in kilometers per hour?
questions.explanation: 1 hour 12 minutes is 1.2 hours (12 minutes = 0.2 hour). 18 km ÷ 1.2 h = 15 km/h.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 7 cm? (Use π = 22/7.)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the area of a circle with a diameter of 14 m? (Use π = 22/7.)
questions.explanation: The radius is 7 m. Area = πr² = 22/7 × 49 = 154 m².

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands at 8:20?
questions.explanation: The minute hand is at 20 × 6 = 120°. The hour hand is at 8 × 30 + 20 × 0.5 = 250°. 250 − 120 = 130°.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: At a meeting, each of 8 people shakes hands once with every other person. How many handshakes are there?
questions.explanation: Each handshake is a pair: 8C2 = (8 × 7) ÷ 2 = 28.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Which fraction is the smallest? 5/9, 4/7, 7/13, 3/5
questions.explanation: As decimals: 0.556, 0.571, 0.538 and 0.6. 7/13 is the smallest.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A car traveling at 60 km/h takes 4 hours for a trip. How long would the same trip take at 80 km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed and time are inversely proportional. The distance is 60 × 4 = 240 km, and 240 ÷ 80 = 3 hours.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the median of 8, 3, 14, 6, 11, 2 and 9?
questions.explanation: In order: 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 11, 14. With seven numbers, the median is the fourth: 8. (7.6 is the mean.)

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: An item priced at ₱2,000 is discounted by 20%, and then by another 10%. What is the final price?
questions.explanation: ₱2,000 × 0.80 = ₱1,600, then ₱1,600 × 0.90 = ₱1,440. Successive discounts are not added together.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A town's population of 50,000 grows by 10% one year and falls by 10% the next. What is the population after two years?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Which is the best buy? 500 g for ₱85, 750 g for ₱120, 1 kg for ₱165, or 250 g for ₱45
questions.explanation: Price per kilogram: ₱170, ₱160, ₱165 and ₱180. The 750 g pack is cheapest per kilogram.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: An item costs ₱560 including 12% VAT. What is its price before VAT?
questions.explanation: Price with VAT = price × 1.12, so price = ₱560 ÷ 1.12 = ₱500. Subtracting 12% of ₱560 would be wrong.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A sales agent gets a base pay of ₱12,000 plus 5% commission on sales. This month she sold ₱84,000. What is her total pay?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A card is drawn at random from cards numbered 1 to 20. What is the probability that its number is a multiple of 4?
questions.explanation: The multiples of 4 are 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20: 5 out of 20, or 1/4.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A fair die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
questions.explanation: Only 5 and 6 are greater than 4: 2 out of 6, or 1/3.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A clinic served 84 patients in January, 105 in February, 126 in March and 168 in April. By what percent did the number rise from March to April?
questions.explanation: The increase is 168 − 126 = 42. 42 ÷ 126 = 1/3, or 33⅓%. (Dividing by 168 would wrongly give 25%.)

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the value of 2⁵ × 2³ ÷ 2⁶?
questions.explanation: Add and subtract exponents with the same base: 5 + 3 − 6 = 2, so the value is 2² = 4.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is √169 − √49?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A floor measures 360 cm by 240 cm. What is the largest square tile that can cover it exactly, without cutting?
questions.explanation: The tile side must divide both 360 and 240. Their greatest common factor is 120.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Buses leave a terminal every 12, 18 and 30 minutes on three routes. All three leave together at 6:00 AM. When do they next leave together?
questions.explanation: The LCM of 12, 18 and 30 is 180 minutes, or 3 hours. 6:00 AM + 3 hours = 9:00 AM.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A cube-shaped box has edges of 40 cm. What is its volume in liters?
questions.explanation: 40 × 40 × 40 = 64,000 cm³. One liter is 1,000 cm³, so the box holds 64 liters.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A guard works from 10:45 PM to 7:15 AM the next day. How long is the shift?
questions.explanation: 10:45 PM to midnight is 1 hour 15 minutes; midnight to 7:15 AM is 7 hours 15 minutes. Total: 8 hours 30 minutes.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: How many 250 mL glasses can be filled from a 1.5 L bottle?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A grade is 30% quizzes and 70% final exam. A student got 85 in quizzes and 90 in the final exam. What is the final grade?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A vendor buys an item for ₱1,250 and has to sell it for ₱1,000. What is the loss as a percent of the cost?
questions.explanation: The loss is ₱250. ₱250 ÷ ₱1,250 = 0.20, or 20%. (Dividing by the selling price would wrongly give 25%.)

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the simple interest on ₱15,000 at 6% a year for 2½ years?
questions.explanation: Interest = principal × rate × time = ₱15,000 × 0.06 × 2.5 = ₱2,250.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A loan of ₱5,000 grows at 10% interest compounded annually. How much interest is owed after 3 years?
questions.explanation: Amount: ₱5,000 × 1.1 × 1.1 × 1.1 = ₱6,655. Interest = ₱6,655 − ₱5,000 = ₱1,655. Simple interest would be only ₱1,500.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A recipe uses flour and sugar in the ratio 5 : 2. How much sugar is needed for 750 g of flour?
questions.explanation: One part is 750 ÷ 5 = 150 g. Sugar is 2 parts: 2 × 150 = 300 g.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is 15% of 240?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: One pipe fills a tank in 12 hours and another fills it in 6 hours. How long will both pipes take together?
questions.explanation: Together they fill 1/12 + 1/6 = 3/12 = 1/4 of the tank per hour, so 4 hours.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A store mixes rice that costs ₱40 per kg with rice that costs ₱55 per kg to make 30 kg worth ₱45 per kg. How many kilograms of the ₱40 rice are used?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A mother's and a daughter's ages add up to 50. Five years ago, the mother was four times as old as the daughter. How old is the daughter now?
questions.explanation: Mother = 50 − d. Five years ago: 45 − d = 4(d − 5), so 45 − d = 4d − 20 and d = 13. Check: the mother is 37; five years ago 32 = 4 × 8.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The sum of four consecutive integers is 90. What is the smallest of them?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ...
questions.explanation: The differences are 5, 7, 9, 11, so the next is +13: 35 + 13 = 48. (These are 2² − 1, 3² − 1, and so on.)

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? 2, 6, 18, 54, ...
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 3: 54 × 3 = 162.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "candid".
questions.explanation: Candid means honest and direct, which is the same as frank.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "lethargic".
questions.explanation: A lethargic person lacks energy, that is, sluggish.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "hostile".
questions.explanation: Hostile means unfriendly or aggressive. Its opposite is friendly.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "optimistic".
questions.explanation: Optimistic means expecting good things; pessimistic means expecting the worst.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does "once in a blue moon" mean?
questions.explanation: Something that happens once in a blue moon happens very seldom.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does "spill the beans" mean?
questions.explanation: To spill the beans is to tell information that was meant to be kept secret.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Neither the manager nor the clerks ___ present at the meeting.
questions.explanation: With "neither ... nor", the verb agrees with the nearer subject. "Clerks" is plural, so "were".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The number of applicants ___ increasing every year.
questions.explanation: "The number of" is singular and takes "is". (Compare "A number of applicants are...", which is plural.)

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: She is very good ___ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The correct expression is "good at" a subject or skill.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: By next year, she ___ in government service for ten years.
questions.explanation: "By next year" points to an action completed before a future time, which needs the future perfect: will have worked.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The award was given to Maria and ___.
questions.explanation: After the preposition "to", use the object pronoun "me". Test it alone: "given to me".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence has parallel structure?
questions.correct: She likes reading, writing and singing.
wrong: She likes reading, writing and to sing.
She likes to read, writing and singing.
She likes reading, to write and sings.
questions.explanation: Items in a list should have the same form. Here all three are -ing words.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation: An imaginary situation in the present uses "were" in the if-clause, even with "I".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The new policy was met with skepticism, and many employees asked for proof that it would work. What does "skepticism" mean here?
questions.explanation: The employees asked for proof, which shows they doubted the policy.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Despite the heavy rain, the volunteers ___ the relief goods on time.
questions.explanation: "Despite" signals that they succeeded anyway, and the past tense fits the sentence.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasingkahulugan ng "marikit"?
questions.explanation: Ang marikit ay nangangahulugang maganda o kaakit-akit.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasalungat ng "matapang"?
questions.explanation: Ang matapang ay hindi natatakot; ang duwag ay madaling matakot.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "butas ang bulsa"?
questions.explanation: Ang taong butas ang bulsa ay walang pera o gipit.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "kumukulo ang dugo"?
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ito kapag labis ang galit ng isang tao.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita: Tumakbo siya ___ mabilis.
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ang "nang" bilang pang-abay na naglalarawan kung paano ginawa ang kilos, gaya ng "tumakbo nang mabilis".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita: Siya ___ ay pupunta sa pulong.
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ang "rin" kapag ang naunang salita ay nagtatapos sa patinig, gaya ng "siya". Ang "din" ay sa katinig.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Anong aspekto ng pandiwa ang "kumakain"?
questions.explanation: Ang "kumakain" ay kilos na kasalukuyang ginagawa o patuloy, kaya imperpektibo.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "abundant".
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large amounts, that is, plentiful.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "adept".
questions.explanation: An adept person is very skilled at something.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "arduous".
questions.explanation: An arduous task needs a lot of effort, so it is difficult.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "concur".
questions.explanation: To concur is to agree with someone or something.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "elated".
questions.explanation: Elated means extremely happy or overjoyed.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "feasible".
questions.explanation: A feasible plan is one that can be done, that is, possible.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "hinder".
questions.explanation: To hinder is to get in the way of, or obstruct, progress.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "integrity".
questions.explanation: Integrity means being honest and having strong moral principles.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "jovial".
questions.explanation: A jovial person is friendly and cheerful.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "negligent".
questions.explanation: Negligent means failing to take proper care, that is, careless.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "obstinate".
questions.explanation: An obstinate person refuses to change their mind: stubborn.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "scrutinize".
questions.explanation: To scrutinize is to look at or examine something very carefully.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "vigilant".
questions.explanation: A vigilant person keeps careful watch for danger or problems.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "zealous".
questions.explanation: Zealous means full of energy and enthusiasm for a cause.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "ascend".
questions.explanation: To ascend is to go up; to descend is to go down.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "expand".
questions.explanation: To expand is to grow larger; to contract is to grow smaller.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "humble".
questions.explanation: Humble means modest. Its opposite is arrogant. Modest is a synonym.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "mandatory".
questions.explanation: Mandatory means required. Its opposite is optional.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "rigid".
questions.explanation: Rigid means stiff or unbending; flexible means able to bend or change.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "vague".
questions.explanation: Vague means unclear. Its opposite is precise or exact.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "inferior".
questions.explanation: Inferior means lower in quality; superior means higher in quality.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "shallow".
questions.explanation: Shallow means not deep; its opposite is deep.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "temporary".
questions.explanation: Temporary means lasting a short time; permanent means lasting.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "hasty".
questions.explanation: Hasty means done too quickly; deliberate means done slowly and carefully.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "acquit".
questions.explanation: To acquit is to declare not guilty; to convict is to declare guilty.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "complex".
questions.explanation: Complex means having many parts or being hard to understand; simple is its opposite.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to call it a day" mean?
questions.correct: To stop working for the day
questions.explanation: You call it a day when you decide to stop what you are doing.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "under the weather" mean?
questions.explanation: Someone under the weather feels a little ill.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to cost an arm and a leg" mean?
questions.explanation: Something that costs an arm and a leg is very expensive.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "the ball is in your court" mean?
questions.correct: It is your turn to act or decide
questions.explanation: When the ball is in your court, the next move is yours.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to see eye to eye" mean?
questions.explanation: People who see eye to eye share the same opinion.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to keep someone posted" mean?
questions.explanation: To keep someone posted is to give them regular updates.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to be on the same page" mean?
questions.explanation: People on the same page understand a situation in the same way.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "a piece of cake" mean?
questions.explanation: A task that is a piece of cake is very easy to do.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The officer gave a terse reply, saying only "No" before closing the window. What does "terse" mean here?
questions.explanation: He said a single word and ended the conversation, so his reply was brief and abrupt.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Because the rules were so convoluted, even the staff could not explain them clearly. What does "convoluted" mean?
questions.explanation: The rules could not be explained clearly, which shows they were complicated.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The mayor's speech was so innocuous that no one, on any side, objected to it. What does "innocuous" mean?
questions.explanation: Nobody objected, which suggests the speech was harmless and did not offend anyone.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: After weeks of delay, the project was finally expedited when the director approved extra staff. What does "expedited" mean?
questions.explanation: Extra staff were added after a delay, so the project was made to move faster.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Mathematics ___ my favorite subject.
questions.explanation: Mathematics ends in s but names one subject, so it takes a singular verb.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The committee ___ its decision this morning.
questions.explanation: A committee acting as one group takes a singular verb, and "its" confirms it. The past tense fits "this morning".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Either the supervisor or the clerks ___ responsible for the files.
questions.explanation: With "either ... or", the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "clerks", which is plural.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ten thousand pesos ___ too much for a pair of shoes.
questions.explanation: An amount of money treated as one total takes a singular verb.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Everyone in the two offices ___ invited to the seminar.
questions.explanation: "Everyone" is singular, even when it refers to many people.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: She ___ the report yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: "Yesterday afternoon" is a finished time in the past, so use the simple past.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: I ___ in this office since 2019.
questions.explanation: "Since 2019" describes something that started in the past and continues now: present perfect.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: When the manager arrived, the meeting ___ already ___.
questions.explanation: The meeting started before another past event (the manager arriving), so use the past perfect.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Look! The bus ___ now.
questions.explanation: "Look!" and "now" show an action happening at this moment: present progressive.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: By the time we arrive, the guests ___.
questions.explanation: The leaving will be finished before a future time, so use the future perfect.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Neither he nor ___ was informed about the meeting.
questions.explanation: The pronoun is part of the subject of "was informed", so use the subject pronoun "I".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: ___ is the employee who received the award?
questions.explanation: "Who" is the subject of "is". Use "whom" only for objects.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Each of the girls brought ___ own lunch.
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, and the group is girls, so the singular pronoun "her" fits.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The manager praised Ana and ___ for the report.
questions.explanation: Ana and he are objects of "praised", so use the object pronoun "him". Test: "praised him".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The office opens ___ 8 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use "at" for a specific clock time.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Her birthday is ___ March 15.
questions.explanation: Use "on" for specific dates and days.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: He is responsible ___ the payroll.
questions.explanation: The correct expression is "responsible for" something.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The new policy differs ___ the old one in several ways.
questions.explanation: Use "differ from" to compare two things.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: There are fewer applicants this year.
wrong: There are less applicants this year.
There is fewer applicants this year.
There are lesser applicants this year.
questions.explanation: Use "fewer" with things you can count, such as applicants. Use "less" for amounts, such as less water.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: The rain will not affect our plans.
wrong: The rain will not effect our plans.
The rain will not affects our plans.
The rain will not affecting our plans.
questions.explanation: "Affect" is usually the verb (to influence); "effect" is usually the noun (a result).

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: Their office is on the second floor.
wrong: There office is on the second floor.
They're office is on the second floor.
Theirs office is on the second floor.
questions.explanation: "Their" shows ownership. "There" is a place, and "they're" means "they are".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: Please lay the box on the table.
wrong: Please lie the box on the table.
Please laid the box on the table.
Please lain the box on the table.
questions.explanation: You lay an object somewhere; people and things lie down by themselves.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: Neither of the reports is complete.
wrong: Neither of the reports are complete.
Neither of the report are complete.
Neither of the reports were complete.
questions.explanation: "Neither" means "not either one", so it is singular and takes "is".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.correct: I feel bad about the delay.
wrong: I feel badly about the delay.
I feels bad about the delay.
I feel badness about the delay.
questions.explanation: "Feel" is a linking verb here, so it is followed by the adjective "bad", not the adverb "badly".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Find the error: "The list of names (A) were (B) posted on the board (C) yesterday (D)."
questions.explanation: The subject is "list", which is singular, so it should be "was", not "were".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Find the error: "She (A) don't (B) know the answer to (C) the question (D)."
questions.explanation: With "she", use "doesn't": she doesn't know.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Find the error: "Each of the (A) employees must submit (B) their (C) time card by Friday (D)."
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so formal usage needs a singular pronoun such as "his or her" time card.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Find the error: "He has went (A) to the bank (B) to deposit (C) the checks (D)."
questions.explanation: The past participle of "go" is "gone": he has gone.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Find the error: "The children (A) was playing (B) in the park (C) all afternoon (D)."
questions.explanation: "Children" is plural, so it should be "were playing".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The applicant was ___ about her chances, so she prepared for every possible question.
questions.explanation: Preparing for every question shows she was not sure of passing: uncertain.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Although the task was ___, he finished it within an hour.
questions.explanation: "Although" sets up a contrast: a hard task finished quickly.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The office was closed ___ the typhoon.
questions.explanation: The typhoon is the reason the office closed, so "because of" fits.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The guidelines were revised to make them ___ to the public, using simpler words.
questions.explanation: Using simpler words makes rules clearer.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: A past situation that did not happen uses "had + past participle" with "would have + past participle".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Which sentence has parallel structure?
questions.correct: The job requires typing quickly, filing accurately and speaking politely.
wrong: The job requires typing quickly, accurate filing and to speak politely.
The job requires to type quickly, filing accurately and polite speaking.
The job requires quick typing, to file accurately and speaking polite.
questions.explanation: All three items use the same form: an -ing word followed by an adverb.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasingkahulugan ng "maralita"?
questions.explanation: Ang maralita ay taong mahirap o dukha.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasingkahulugan ng "tampalasan"?
questions.explanation: Ang tampalasan ay bastos o walang galang.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng "panibugho"?
questions.explanation: Ang panibugho ay matinding selos.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasalungat ng "masaya"?
questions.explanation: Ang kasalungat ng masaya ay malungkot.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasalungat ng "malawak"?
questions.explanation: Ang malawak ay maluwang; ang makitid ay masikip o hindi maluwang.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "nagsusunog ng kilay"?
questions.explanation: Ang nagsusunog ng kilay ay masipag mag-aral, kahit hanggang gabi.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "di makabasag-pinggan"?
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ito sa taong mahinhin o tahimik kumilos.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Embarrass has a double r and a double s.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Government keeps the n from "govern": govern + ment.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Privilege has no d, and both i and e come in the pattern p-r-i-v-i-l-e-g-e.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Recommend has one c and a double m.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is misspelled?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is "definitely", from "definite".

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Bureaucracy starts with "bureau" (b-u-r-e-a-u) and ends with "cracy".

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is misspelled?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is "apparent", ending in -ent.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Schedule is spelled s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which name is exactly the same as "Leonora C. Pangilinan-Uy"?
questions.explanation: The others change the middle initial, one letter in the first name, or drop the hyphen.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many of these pairs are exactly alike? (1) Noel B. Sarmiento / Noel B. Sarmiento (2) Imelda F. Quiambao / Imelda F. Quiambao (3) Arnel T. Dizon / Arnel T. Dison (4) Jocelyn M. Tuazon / Jocelyn N. Tuazon
questions.explanation: Pairs 1 and 2 are the same. Pair 3 changes Dizon to Dison, and pair 4 changes M to N.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which number is exactly the same as 09175-338-206?
questions.explanation: The others swap two digits in one group.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: How many of these pairs are exactly alike? 662190 / 662190; 4.0375 / 4.0357; 81-0093 / 81-0093; 5501882 / 5508182
questions.explanation: The first and third pairs match. The second swaps 75 and 57; the fourth swaps 18 and 81.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Compare the account numbers 4402-1187-3365-0912 and 4402-1187-3356-0912. In which group is the difference?
